entities.summary: Berkrerk Chartvanchai was a Thai professional Muay Thai fighter and boxer. He was a WBA World Flyweight Champion, the third Thai in history to hold a version of the World Flyweight title .. In Muay Thai he was a two weight Lumpinee Stadium Champion.
